_about: Everything needed to simulate/estimate a freshly generated map. Square grid, Chebyshev distance, coordinates (x,y), index = y*size+x. Tile counts are size*size.

map_sizes.note: Perfection=normal 16x16; Domination: 1 opp tiny, 2 small, 3 normal, 4+ large. Tiny supports <=9 players, others <=16.

map_types.note: PE implements only 3 of the 6 wiki types; continents/pangea/archipelago pipelines are UNKNOWN (gap G1).

sector_grid.note: PE formula and wiki table agree exactly.

sector_assignment.v: players are assigned to a uniformly random permutation of the sector cells (extra sectors stay empty)

base_span.v: size // grid ; leftover = size - base_span*grid is distributed as origin offsets: origin(c)=c*base_span + min(leftover, max(1, min(leftover,c)-1))

eligible_cells.v: inner margin = 2 if base_span>4 else 1; x,y in [max(2,origin+margin), min(size-2, origin+span-margin)) ; wiki: capitals never within 2 tiles of a domain border

cell_weight.v: weight = max over ALL sector centres of max(1, base_span//2 - chebyshev(cell, centre))^3  (cubic pull towards a sector centre)
cell_weight.note: Wiki only says 'random within domain'. Cubic weighting is PE's reading of the reference generator.

capital_guarantees.v: capital tile = City + Road. The 4 orthogonal neighbours of every capital are forced to Land.

spacing.v: a village/suburb must be >2 (Chebyshev) from every city/village/capital, i.e. >=3 apart; never on map edge; <=1 per 3x3 area

map_types: lakes (PE) ; wiki: all except drylands & water world

suburbs.note: Suburbs are villages placed close to a capital: PE draws candidates in the 9x9 square around it. Wiki says 'all map types except Drylands and Water World' (so also continents etc.)

pre_terrain_count.v: floor((grid_slots - capitals - suburbs) * density) ; density lakes=0.30, waterworld=0.10, drylands=0.0
pre_terrain_count.note: Wiki: ~30% of theoretical max placed before terrain (10% water world, 0% drylands).

post_terrain_target.v: PE: tries grid_slots - capitals - pre_terrain villages, placing on LAND cells with x,y in [2,size-3] and >2 from every city; stops when no candidate. WIKI: 'about 60% after terrain' (80% drylands).
post_terrain_target.note: Real post-terrain village count is therefore uncertain. Empirically count villages in real games to fix this.

lakes.land_locked: capitals, suburbs, pre-terrain villages and the 4 neighbours of each capital are forced land
lakes.field: uniform random noise, locked-land cells = 1.0, outside the map counts as 1.0 (dry edges), 2 passes of 3x3 mean smoothing

water_fraction.v: water tiles = randint(ceil(0.25*N), floor(0.28*N)) lowest-field unlocked cells
water_fraction.note: 0.25/0.28 are PE's tuned constants ('kLakesMinWaterFraction' etc.), not wiki facts.

waterworld.note: Corners are NOT forced to land in water world (PE).

drylands.water: none, except 2 fish water tiles beside Kickoo/Aquarion capitals

shallow_vs_ocean.v: a water tile edge-adjacent (4-neighbour) to land/forest/mountain is 'shallow Water'; every other water tile is deep 'Ocean'. Diagonal-only contact = ocean.

corners.v: In non-waterworld maps the four corner tiles are forced Land with no resource/settlement; they are the 4 LIGHTHOUSE tiles.

method.v: each capital claims land by alternating 4-directional border growth in a freshly shuffled player order each round; each claim picks a uniformly random tile among the claimant's whole current frontier. Disconnected land goes to the nearest capital by Chebyshev distance.
method.note: Wiki: 'neighbouring tribes can influence capital terrain on 121-tile maps'.

base_shares.note: Enforced as exact shares since update 2.0.58 per wiki (PE draws i.i.d., so counts are only approximate).

modifier_rule.v: mountain = 0.14*mod_m ; forest_before = 0.38 + (0.14-mountain)*(0.38/0.86) ; forest = min(forest_before*mod_f, 1-mountain) ; field = remainder
modifier_rule.note: Wiki: mountains applied first (affect forest+field), forest next (affects only field).

area.v: resources appear only within Chebyshev distance 2 of ANY city/village/capital; 'inner' = distance 1 (the 8 tiles around it)

rates.note: NUMBERS agree between wiki and PE, INTERPRETATION does not. PE reads them as P(resource | terrain), e.g. P(fruit|field,inner)=0.18. The wiki rows sum to the terrain total (18+18+12=48), i.e. they are shares of ALL tiles, which implies P(fruit|field,inner)=0.375. Expected resources in the 8-tile inner ring: PE ~2.1, wiki reading ~5.3. Settle with C23 test before trusting either. Multiply by tribe modifiers (fruit, crops, animals, metal).

shallow.v: 0.50 * tribe_fish_mod, only inside the resource area

ocean.note: PE: 'public docs do not define a numeric ocean rate' - 0.10 is a tuned guess. Wiki says fish can appear in ocean inside borders.

fish.water_tile_tribe: water has no tribe; PE uses the nearest generated land biome's tribe for the fish modifier

resources.excluded: corner tiles and tiles that hold a settlement get no resource

capital_guarantee.WK_says: EVERY capital has >=2 identical resources within its ring: Xin-xi 2 metal, Oumaji 2 fruit, Hoodrick 2 animals; Bardur/Imperius/Kickoo/Zebasi/Elyrion/Cymanti tied to their start tech; all others 2 of a random tier-1 resource (fish, animal or fruit). Missing ones are force-spawned by replacing tiles.
capital_guarantee.use_for_fog: STRONG PRIOR: the 3x3 ring around an unseen enemy capital contains >=2 of the same resource; for most tribes the type is known.

tribe_modifiers._note: Missing key = 1.0. fish/animals/fruit/crops/metal multiply the resource rates; forest/mountain feed biome_assignment.modifier_rule.

Kickoo.note: WK also lists 2.0x water, but water mods are NOT applied by the game (WK).

Aquarion.note: WK: 1.5x water exists in code but has no effect.

Bardur.note: WK instead says '1.5x fruit, 0x crop'. Unresolved.

Luxidoor.note: WK table: base rate. (Luxidoor page: '++fruit, -game' - unquantified, ignored.)

Elyrion.note: PE has NO modifiers for Elyrion.

Polaris.note: WK: no own rates; land converts to Polaris terrain; mirror/mixed uses Imperius land.

Cymanti.note: PE has no modifiers for Cymanti.

count_by_tiles.note: Formula for other sizes: round(tiles*23/900). Wiki page gave no counts.

placement.v: random non-corner tile with no settlement; PE requires no settlement within Chebyshev 2

ruins.wiki_rule: WK: cannot spawn on shallow water, nor next to a village, city or another ruin.

starfish.placement: non-corner water tile with no resource and no settlement in its 3x3

reward_stars.note: collected when a unit enters the tile

starfish.wiki_flag: WK marks 'no adjacent starfish' as possibly incorrect

known_version_notes: 2.0.58 (Balance Pass 2): terrain percentages followed as exactly as possible.
Water rules pre-date Path of the Ocean update and may be outdated (WK).
Kickoo/Aquarion 'continents' 40%/30% water replacement is bugged and does nothing (WK).
